locations.note: Lara's hunt for the Scion begins in the Peruvian Andes: through the lost city of Vilcabamba and the Lost Valley to the tomb of Qualopec.
St Francis' Folly: Lara descends through a ruined monastery into the chambers of four gods, past the Colosseum and Midas's palace, to the tomb of Tihocan.
Through the lost city of Khamoon to the Sanctuary of the Scion beneath the Sphinx, where Lara takes the third piece and Natla ambushes her.
The final levels take Lara to the lost island of Atlantis, placed where Plato put it: beyond the Pillars of Heracles, out in the Atlantic.
The training level at Lara's home, reached from the menu.

routes.name: The hunt for the Scion
routes.note: Peru, Greece, Egypt, then the lost island of Atlantis.
